rows.text: "Clang! Bang!" The sounds of clashing weapons echo across the training grounds as the Holy City Guards carry out their routine drills.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Thrust, upward slash, change of guard, disarm... You execute a flawless sequence of attacks, and your opponent's iron sword clatters to the ground. As you shake your arm, sore from gripping the wooden sword for far too long, your observing colleagues burst into applause and admiration.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Your swordplay has improved tremendously. Once you complete the Final Trial, you'll be the undisputed choice for Captain of the Holy City Guards." The sword instructor's eyes gleamed with approval, "Your opponent will be a Kin of Strife. Think you can win?"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The promised day has arrived. With your sword in hand, you approach your formidable foe, towering like a mountain, its bronze mask gleaming in the sunlight. Citizens gather around, bearing witness to this epic confrontation...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
